faq: Can the settings page match my billing area?
Yes. If you have a billing portal, we link it in. If you do not, our subscription billing services can build one, and we keep the design consistent.
Is deleting an account safe to offer?
Yes, if done carefully. We add a confirmation step and a short grace period if you want. Rules on keeping records vary, so check your policy. We do not give legal advice.
Do you change my existing database?
Only slightly, such as adding a column for preferences. We list every change first and run it on a copy. Existing data remains as it is.
Can I add my own settings sections?
Yes. The page is built from separate sections, so adding one later is quick. Premium includes notes that show your developer exactly how to do it.
